answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real stake and burn computation, while honest agents recover their bond. Require each agent to stake a jade token bond locked for the epoch and to submit a proof-of-work challenge whose difficulty scales with prior identities. A canyon-shaped decay curve narrows eligibility over time, and a single verified signal from a peer quorum slashes bonds on duplicates, making mass identity creation costlier than the rewards it can capture. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
